answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. To claim one slot, an agent burns a deposit equal to twice its 30-day earnings, refunded only after 20 epochs of honest service. Like a reef growing coral by coral, each slot is earned singly: a relic of past work cannot open a second slot, and every new inlet of tasks needs its own burn. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 deposits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
